_about: Key poses of the clips: where the strike lands (contact_s) and the poses the move data snaps to. 30 fps, baked by retarget_ual.py from the free Quaternius clips (CC0). Use these seconds as clip_s in moves.json anim.keys.

idle.note: Idle_Loop at half speed: a heavy breath

walk.note: Walk_Loop slowed so the stride matches walk speed_mps (12 m/s); stride_mps is in the key data

swing_r_windup.note: Scrap Swing wind-up: the first 0.19 s of Sword_Regular_A at 0.1x = 1.9 s (the arm hauls back).

swing_r_strike.note: Scrap Swing strike: Sword_Regular_A through the swing at 0.12x (the 0.9 s sweep of the hitboxes) and its recovery at 0.3x; contact = the start of the sweep.

swing_l_windup.note: Scrap Swing wind-up: the first 0.19 s of Sword_Regular_A at 0.1x = 1.9 s (the arm hauls back). Mirrored: the left arm.

swing_l_strike.note: Scrap Swing strike: Sword_Regular_A through the swing at 0.12x (the 0.9 s sweep of the hitboxes) and its recovery at 0.3x; contact = the start of the sweep. Mirrored: the left arm.

drop_windup.note: Wrecking Drop wind-up: Sword_Heavy_Combo 2.0 to 2.5 s (the overhead raise) at 0.22x = 2.3 s.

drop_strike.note: Wrecking Drop strike: the slam of Sword_Heavy_Combo (contact at 2.6 s of the source), then the slammed crouch drifts and holds (arms stuck in the ground).

stomp_windup.note: Stomp March wind-up: the right foot of Walk_Loop lifts (0.2 to 0.42 s) at 0.14x = 1.6 s.

stomp_strike.note: Stomp March strike: the right foot drops (first stomp = contact), the left lifts and drops one second later (extra_contacts_s), then it stands still while it catches its balance.

barrage_windup.note: Scrap Barrage wind-up: OverhandThrow 0 to 0.3 s (arm back and up) at 0.17x = 1.8 s.

barrage_strike.source: UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow + UAL2:OverhandThrow
barrage_strike.note: Scrap Barrage strike: three throws of OverhandThrow, 0.6 s apart (contact and extra_contacts_s are the releases); the arm is wound back between them by playing the follow-through in reverse.

hurt.note: plate-hit flinch: Hit_Chest at a third of its speed (about 1 s, the plate_break recoil)

stagger.note: cab opens (core_reveal): Hit_Chest at 0.3x then the end pose held; 2.6 s, exactly the move (the importer loops this name)

roar.note: last stand: arms thrashing (Zombie_Scratch at 0.8x = 2.25 s); the brute's enrage uses the same clip

knockdown.note: defeat collapse: Death01 at half speed = 4.8 s, then holds the pose on the floor: 5.0 s, the length of the move
